using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using StackExchange.Redis;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Hosting.Tests;

public class RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilderTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ISiloBuilder> _mockSiloBuilder;
    private readonly Mock<IConfigurationSection> _mockConfigSection;
    private readonly Mock<IConfiguration> _mockRootConfig;
    private readonly Mock<IConfiguration> _mockConnectionStringConfig;

    public RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilderTests()
    {
        _mockSiloBuilder = new Mock<ISiloBuilder>();
        _mockConfigSection = new Mock<IConfigurationSection>();
        _mockRootConfig = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
        _mockConnectionStringConfig = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Configure_WithServiceKey_SetsCreateMultiplexerAndEmptyConfigOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns("test-key");
        
        var mockOptionsBuilder = new Mock<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
        var mockConfigureAction = new Mock<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>();
        mockConfigureAction.Setup(a => a.Invoke(It.IsAny<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>(), It.IsAny<IServiceProvider>()))
            .Verifiable();

        var mockAddRedisGrainDirectory = _mockSiloBuilder.Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory("test", It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
            .Returns(_mockSiloBuilder.Object)
            .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
            {
                var optionsBuilder = new Mock<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
                optionsBuilder.Setup(o => o.Configure<IServiceProvider>(It.IsAny<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>()))
                    .Callback<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>((configureAction) =>
                    {
                        var services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();
                        var mockMultiplexer = new Mock<IConnectionMultiplexer>();
                        services.GetRequiredService = (serviceType, key) => mockMultiplexer.Object;
                        
                        var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
                        configureAction(options, services);
                        
                        // Verify the configuration was set correctly
                        Assert.NotNull(options.CreateMultiplexer);
                        Assert.NotNull(options.ConfigurationOptions);
                        Assert.Equal(default, options.ConfigurationOptions.EndPoints);
                    });
                action(optionsBuilder.Object);
            });

        // Act
        builder.Configure(_mockSiloBuilder.Object, "test", _mockConfigSection.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Configure_WithConnectionNameAndNoConnectionString_CallsGetConnectionString()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns((string)null);
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ConnectionName"]).Returns("test-connection");
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ConnectionString"]).Returns((string)null);
        _mockRootConfig.Setup(c => c.GetConnectionString("test-connection")).Returns("redis://localhost:6379");

        var calledWithConnectionString = false;
        _mockSiloBuilder.Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory("test", It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
            .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
            {
                var services = new ServiceCollection();
                services.AddSingleton<IConfiguration>(_mockRootConfig.Object);
                var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

                var optionsBuilder = new Mock<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
                optionsBuilder.Setup(o => o.Configure<IServiceProvider>(It.IsAny<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>()))
                    .Callback<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>(action =>
                    {
                        var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
                        action(options, serviceProvider);
                        Assert.NotNull(options.ConfigurationOptions);
                        calledWithConnectionString = true;
                    });
                action(optionsBuilder.Object);
            });

        // Act
        builder.Configure(_mockSiloBuilder.Object, "test", _mockConfigSection.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(calledWithConnectionString);
        _mockRootConfig.Verify(c => c.GetConnectionString("test-connection"), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Configure_WithDirectConnectionString_UsesParsedConfigurationOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns((string)null);
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ConnectionString"]).Returns("redis://localhost:6379");

        var parsedOptions = default(ConfigurationOptions);
        _mockSiloBuilder.Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory("test", It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
            .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
            {
                var services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();
                var optionsBuilder = new Mock<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
                optionsBuilder.Setup(o => o.Configure<IServiceProvider>(It.IsAny<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>()))
                    .Callback<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>(configure =>
                    {
                        var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
                        configure(options, services);
                        parsedOptions = options.ConfigurationOptions;
                    });
                action(optionsBuilder.Object);
            });

        // Act
        builder.Configure(_mockSiloBuilder.Object, "test", _mockConfigSection.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(parsedOptions);
        Assert.Equal("localhost", parsedOptions.EndPoints.First().Host);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Configure_WithConnectionNameAndConnectionString_UsesDirectConnectionString()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = new RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder();
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ServiceKey"]).Returns((string)null);
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ConnectionName"]).Returns("test-connection");
        _mockConfigSection.Setup(c => c["ConnectionString"]).Returns("direct://redis:6379");

        _mockSiloBuilder.Setup(b => b.AddRedisGrainDirectory("test", It.IsAny<Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>()))
            .Callback<string, Action<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>>((name, action) =>
            {
                var services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();
                var optionsBuilder = new Mock<OptionsBuilder<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions>>();
                optionsBuilder.Setup(o => o.Configure<IServiceProvider>(It.IsAny<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>()))
                    .Callback<Action<RedisGrainDirectoryOptions, IServiceProvider>>(configure =>
                    {
                        var options = new RedisGrainDirectoryOptions();
                        configure(options, services);
                        // Should use direct ConnectionString, not call GetConnectionString
                        Assert.NotNull(options.ConfigurationOptions);
                    });
                action(optionsBuilder.Object);
            });

        // Act
        builder.Configure(_mockSiloBuilder.Object, "test", _mockConfigSection.Object);

        // Assert - GetConnectionString should NOT be called when ConnectionString is provided
        _mockRootConfig.Verify(c => c.GetConnectionString(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Never);
    }
}
